taiwan_aviation.headline: 國防部稱國慶前夕偵獲19架次共機　13架次越過中線
taiwan_aviation.summary: 國防部10月9日表示，自上午8時52分起，陸續偵獲19架次共軍主、輔戰機及無人機出海，其中13架次逾越臺灣海峽中線，進入臺灣北部、中部與西南空域，並配合共艦活動。這是當日特定時段的通報，不是全年或整日累計數字。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: Taiwan reports nineteen PLA aircraft sorties on National Day eve
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: Taiwan's defense ministry said on October 9 that it detected nineteen PLA aircraft sorties from 08:52 onward, including thirteen crossing the Taiwan Strait median line into northern, central and southwestern airspace. The aircraft operated alongside Chinese naval vessels. The announcement concerns a particular activity period, rather than an annual or full-day cumulative count.

taiwan_aviation.headline: 經濟部覈定27案無人機研發補助　漢翔獲1億元最高
taiwan_aviation.summary: 中央社10月9日報導，經濟部覈定27件無人機研發補助，總額約7.8億元，其中漢翔高承載物流無人機計畫獲1億元，為本年度單案最高，金額均為新臺幣。申請49案、覈定率約55%，支持範圍較去年擴大至整機與關鍵技術。
taiwan_aviation.headline_en: Taiwan approves twenty-seven drone R&D grants; AIDC receives TWD100 million
taiwan_aviation.summary_en: Taiwan's economy ministry approved twenty-seven drone research grants totaling approximately TWD780 million, CNA reported on October 9. AIDC's heavy-payload logistics-drone project receives TWD100 million, the year's largest individual award. Forty-nine applications were submitted, with about fifty-five percent approved as support expands beyond components.

international_aviation.headline: 美國陸軍報告指出無線電通訊中斷促成致命空中相撞
international_aviation.summary: 美國陸軍一份關於美國航空Flight 5342與陸軍直升機致命空中相撞的報告已公開。相撞於2025年1月29日發生在羅納德·雷根國家機場附近；客機為PSA Airlines營運的龐巴迪CRJ700，直升機為美國陸軍UH-60L Black Hawk。
international_aviation.headline_en: U.S. Army report cites interrupted radio transmissions in fatal midair collision
international_aviation.summary_en: A U.S. Army report into the fatal midair collision involving American Airlines Flight 5342 and an Army helicopter has been made public. The collision occurred near Ronald Reagan National Airport on 29 January 2025. The jet was a Bombardier CRJ700 operated by PSA Airlines; the helicopter was a US Army UH-60L Black Hawk.

international_aviation.headline_en: Air Canada reveals new A321XLR routes from Montreal and Halifax to Europe with lie-flat suites and WiFi
international_aviation.summary_en: Air Canada has revealed a new A321XLR route, opening new links from Montreal and Halifax to Europe with nonstop flights of up to eight hours. The headline notes "But There's A Twist", indicating that further specifics about the plans remain to be clarified.

international_aviation.headline: 空中巴士9月交付72架 第四季須交付323架才能達成全年目標
international_aviation.summary: 空中巴士（Airbus）公佈9月商業飛機交付與訂單資料。該公司9月交付72架商業飛機，2026年前九個月累計交付547架。這批9月訂單與交付數據由這家歐洲飛機製造商於10月8日確認，當月交付給37家客戶，並取得17架新飛機訂單。
international_aviation.headline_en: Airbus delivered 72 aircraft in September, leaving 323 to reach 2026 target
international_aviation.summary_en: Airbus delivered 72 commercial aircraft in September, bringing its 2026 total to 547, the manufacturer said. The European planemaker confirmed its September orders and deliveries on 8 October, reporting 72 deliveries to 37 customers and 17 new aircraft orders.

international_aviation.headline: Queen Suthida駕駛Saab Gripen單飛，飛行41分鐘
international_aviation.summary: Aerospace Global News報導，泰國王后 Queen Suthida 於週四（10月8日）駕駛泰國皇家空軍單座 Saab JAS 39C Gripen 戰機單飛。她完成預定飛行，41分鐘後返回 Wing 7。
international_aviation.headline_en: Thailand’s Queen Suthida completes 41-minute solo flight in Saab Gripen
international_aviation.summary_en: Aerospace Global News reported that Queen Suthida of Thailand flew solo in a Royal Thai Air Force single-seat Saab JAS 39C Gripen on Thursday (8 October). She completed the planned sortie and returned to Wing 7 after 41 minutes.

international_aviation.headline: 波音為737 MAX與NG提供觸控控制面板，飛行員質疑操作性
international_aviation.summary: 波音正為737 MAX與NG客機提供觸控式控制顯示單元（TCDU）替換方案。新面板以觸控螢幕取代實體按鈕，但按鈕配置與版面維持不變。波音表示，觸控面板將成為737 MAX 10標準配備，也可改裝至737 NG與MAX客機。
international_aviation.headline_en: Boeing offers touchscreen control unit for 737 MAX and NG aircraft
international_aviation.summary_en: Boeing is offering a drop-in replacement for the Touchscreen Control Display Unit (TCDU) on 737 MAX and NG aircraft. The replacement uses a touchscreen instead of the old button panel, while leaving the button configuration and layout unchanged. Boeing says the touchscreen is to become standard in MAX 10 models and can also be retrofitted into 737 NG and MAX aircraft.

international_aviation.headline: 利雅德週四近300架次航班取消或未營運
international_aviation.summary: Aerospace Global News報導，週四往返利雅德的航班中，近300架次取消或未營運。報導引述Cirium數據，並稱相關數字由Khaleej Times報導；金哈立德國際機場當天378架次預定離場航班中，有169架次取消或未營運，約佔離場航班45%。
international_aviation.headline_en: Nearly 300 Riyadh Flights Cancelled or Did Not Operate Thursday
international_aviation.summary_en: Aerospace Global News reported that nearly 300 flights to and from Riyadh were cancelled or did not operate on Thursday. The report cited Cirium figures reported by Khaleej Times: 169 of 378 scheduled departures from King Khalid International Airport were cancelled or did not operate, representing about 45% of departures.
